title: Operator manual sells versus the routine retry pause

options.name: Keep current behaviour: dashboard sells are routine and are refused while paused
options.risk: The operator is told to act manually and the dashboard refuses with a misleading message (AUD-EXIT-008).

options.name: Give operator sells their own reason that bypasses the pause, and report the real reason when a sell does not run
options.behavior_impact: The dashboard can always try to sell a held position.
options.risk: An operator can keep retrying a sell that always reverts (gas).

options.name: Keep the pause for operator sells but add an explicit resume control
options.behavior_impact: One more click; the pause stays meaningful.

recommendation: operator-reason, decided together with the ESC-PRE-04 selection fix.
default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). This card covers S1 capital findings, which cannot rest on the default: until it is decided and fixed it blocks the live re-entry gate.
behavior_impact: Decides whether the operator can always sell from the dashboard.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
